summary: The small model started a plausible dashboard but stopped inside CSS before producing a complete document body or JavaScript. The skill is too broad for this model/context setting and needs a compact execution strategy that prioritizes a complete, valid HTML artifact over visual ambition.

Explicitly require the model to close `</style>`, complete `<body>`, include one `<script>`, and close `</script></body></html>`.

Tell the model not to spend many tokens on large CSS systems before the HTML body exists.
Add a final self-check that incomplete CSS, missing body, missing script, or unclosed tags fail the task.
Keep the audit marker, but make the marker a final checklist rather than relying on broad prose in the prompt.
